habitat: Subtropical/tropical moist lowland and montane forest from 1000-3100 m
story: In the diverse world of birds, the Golden Naped Barbet (Psilopogon pulcherrimus) stands out. This species, part of the Megalaimidae family, is a resident of Subtropical/tropical moist lowland and montane forest from 1000-3100 m. Its IUCN Red List status is Least Concern (LC), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Golden Naped Barbet is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Golden Naped Barbet and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
